description: Compares two named snapshots keyword by keyword: rank before and after (null included), how the result set size changed, which apps entered or left the top 10, and your ratings against the competitor median on each date. Rows are grouped by the labels given when saving. READ THE CONTROLS FIRST: if keywords you expected to hold still have moved, the whole comparison is drift and the targets prove nothing. Deliberately reports no significance or confidence -- with small numbers there is no statistical power, and a confidence label would be theatre.
name: snapshot_diff
title: Compare two rank snapshots
